name: context-bar
description: A Claude Code mod that draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category, with a token legend — and says when to compact: a hint, then a warning, then what will be lost, as auto-compact gets close. Toggled with /context-bar; refreshes after every turn from a local estimate, so it sends no token-count requests.

interface.longDescription: A Claude Code mod that draws the context window as a stacked bar above the prompt, one colour per /context category, with a token legend — and says when to compact: a hint, then a warning, then what will be lost, as auto-compact gets close. Toggled with /context-bar; refreshes after every turn from a local estimate, so it sends no token-count requests. Ships Claude Code hooks that this plugin has not yet adapted for Codex. Automatic hook behavior is disabled here; skill instructions remain advisory.
